title: Bedrock passthrough must build a new body and never mutate the caller's payload
answers: Bedrock Claude fallback sends the wrong body after the first provider fails
Why does the Anthropic passthrough payload lose model or stream on Bedrock
How do I add a passthrough body transform for a provider behind FallbackProvider
Bedrock InvokeModel request body anthropic_version bedrock-2023-05-31
body:
Invariant: AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough builds a new body dict for InvokeModel and leaves the caller's payload untouched. FallbackProvider hands the same payload to the next provider when this one fails, so an in-place edit corrupts the fallback leg.
Enforced by: mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py:AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough (body is a dict comprehension that drops "model" and "stream", then sets anthropic_version on that copy).
Bedrock takes the model from the URL path and streaming from the path suffix -with-response-stream, so both keys are removed from the body; anthropic_version is set to bedrock-2023-05-31.
Test: tests/gateway/providers/test_bedrock.py:test_bedrock_anthropic_passthrough_posts_to_invoke asserts payload["model"] is unchanged after the call.
What breaks if skipped: the next provider in a fallback chain receives a body missing its model or already carrying Bedrock-only keys, so the failover leg returns an error.
applies: Any passthrough added to a provider whose request payload can be reused by FallbackProvider.
says: Fallback to secondary provider fails because the model parameter is missing from the request.
Failover after a Bedrock error sends a corrupted payload to the backup model provider.
Streaming and model fields disappear when failing over from Bedrock to another provider.
Ensure provider failover chains preserve the original request payload when Bedrock calls fail.
search: AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py must construct a new body dictionary for InvokeModel rather than modifying the caller's payload in place. Because FallbackProvider reuses the same request payload for subsequent providers if Bedrock fails, in-place deletion of model or stream or addition of anthropic_version bedrock-2023-05-31 corrupts the fallback failover leg. Applies to any passthrough used with FallbackProvider and is tested by tests/gateway/providers/test_bedrock.py:test_bedrock_anthropic_passthrough_posts_to_invoke asserting payload['model'] remains unchanged.
